<!--
Protected area coverage (child of report_main.Rmd)

Expects params$protected: the list returned by compute_protected()
(helpers/protected_areas.R), ideally without the large `pa_all` element.
Uses `style_pdf_table()` and `ecosystem_label` from the parent.
The section heading itself is added in report_main.Rmd.
-->

```{r pa_setup, include=FALSE}
pa_res  <- params$protected
has_pa  <- !is.null(pa_res) && is.list(pa_res) && !is.null(pa_res$summary)

if (has_pa) {
  pa_sum   <- pa_res$summary
  pa_cats  <- pa_res$by_category
  pa_sites <- pa_res$by_site
  has_cats  <- !is.null(pa_cats)  && nrow(pa_cats)  > 0
  has_sites <- !is.null(pa_sites) && nrow(pa_sites) > 0
} else {
  has_cats <- has_sites <- FALSE
}

fmt_km2 <- function(x) format(round(x, 0), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
fmt_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)

# Plain-language names for the IUCN management categories
pa_cat_names <- c(
  "Ia"             = "Strict nature reserve",
  "Ib"             = "Wilderness area",
  "II"             = "National park",
  "III"            = "Natural monument or feature",
  "IV"             = "Habitat/species management area",
  "V"              = "Protected landscape/seascape",
  "VI"             = "Protected area with sustainable use",
  "Not Reported"   = "Category not reported",
  "Not Assigned"   = "Category not assigned",
  "Not Applicable" = "Category not applicable",
  "OECM"           = "Other effective area-based conservation measure"
)
```

```{r pa_text, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval = has_pa}
if (pa_sum$prot_km2 > 0) {
  cat(paste0(
    "Of the **", fmt_km2(pa_sum$eco_km2), " km^2^** mapped extent of the ecosystem, an estimated **",
    fmt_km2(pa_sum$prot_km2), " km^2^ (",
    fmt_pct(pa_sum$pct_protected), ")** lies within protected areas recorded in the ",
    "[World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas (WDPCA)](https://www.protectedplanet.net/). ",
    "**", fmt_pct(pa_sum$pct_strict), "** falls within strictly protected areas ",
    "(IUCN categories Ia, Ib and II)."
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    "No protected areas recorded in the World Database on Protected and Conserved ",
    "Areas (WDPCA) overlap the mapped extent of the ", ecosystem_label, "."
  ))
}
```

```{r pa_by_category, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = has_cats}
cat_df <- data.frame(
  `IUCN category`  = as.character(pa_cats$Category),
  Description      = unname(pa_cat_names[as.character(pa_cats$Category)]),
  area             = fmt_km2(pa_cats$area_km2),
  `% of ecosystem` = fmt_pct(pa_cats$pct_eco),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

flextable::flextable(cat_df) |>
  style_pdf_table(caption_text = "Ecosystem within protected areas, by IUCN management category") |>
  flextable::compose(j = "area", part = "header",
                     value = flextable::as_paragraph("Area (km", flextable::as_sup("2"), ")"))
```

```{r pa_by_site, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = has_sites}
site_df <- pa_sites
site_df <- site_df[, names(site_df) != "Area (km2)", drop = FALSE]   # drop the area column
names(site_df)[names(site_df) == "Site"] <- "Protected Area"
names(site_df)[names(site_df) == "IUCN"] <- "IUCN category"

flextable::flextable(site_df) |>
  style_pdf_table(caption_text = "Protected areas overlapping the ecosystem") |>
  flextable::add_footer_lines(
    "Protected areas from the WDPCA can overlap - percentages may not sum to the protected area total.") |>
  flextable::italic(part = "footer") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") |>
  flextable::align(align = "left", part = "footer")
```
